coder_notes: Registered drug name NanO2TM; also referred to as NVX-108 in outcomes; other name dodecafluoropentane emulsion (DDFPe), used as active moiety. Temozolomide is not a separate registered intervention but every patient receives it with radiotherapy (Stupp), so listed as soc_backbone. 'primary or secondary glioblastoma multiforme' allows secondary (IDH-mutant) GBM, hence historical terminology. Target engagement = TOLD MRI tumour oxygenation (pharmacodynamic imaging). Placebo saline listed as control_comparator.
